t.shapeFaq.social-resize.a1: Crop when the subject sits comfortably inside the new shape: the image fills the whole screen and looks native to the platform. By default the crop follows the most interesting part of the picture, and for photos you can drag the frame to choose exactly which part is kept. Fit when nothing may be cut off, such as a group photo or a poster with text near the edges; the whole picture stays visible on a blurred copy of itself or on a white or black background.
